READ-ONLY DIRECT-UNICODE INPUT AUDIT — exact state, matrix, proposed paths, and gate

Scope and authority

This is the chief-assigned no-path slice for bd-01M1998654XQRSNA6R16S2ABDQ. It proposes no edit, reservation, module, dependency, public vocabulary, candidate, landing, or fixture authority.

Exact repository state

- storymodel4s current committed HEAD is e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a on main. The checkout is shared and dirty. At that exact commit, StorySource and SurfaceAnalyzer are tracked public APIs, but there is no tracked CLI, HTML/SVG renderer, output-result implementation, or story-output bundle specification. The output Scala files and accepted spec visible in the shared checkout are untracked recovery evidence, reserved to codex-storymodel4s-collab under bd-01M1CHWCRKMPNK6RARGT7JXVXX; they are not current-main API. Candidate cand-2A9ZTSWMSJEPN68DATQBWNS86V at 8a110880ff6dcc53affdb3fff2dd2e730f7ce906 remains blocked. The newer ca9bcfa object is self-blocked and has no candidate row.
- storyatlas4s current committed HEAD is 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5 on main. It has no configured Git remote. Its worktree has uncommitted changes in Edition.scala, CodexHtml.scala, their suites, and e2e/static/static.cjs. Its own Mote store reports no live reservation on Main.scala, Edition.scala, or CodexHtml.scala, but the dirty bytes remain someone else's work and are not an implementation base.
- StoryAtlas pins storymodel4s 3cf704a743d251b0ca09a3238b059e41883370af, an ancestor 266 commits behind e584ad6. That pin has no output-result/bundle files. StoryAtlas currently exposes only `edition --out <dir>`.

Exact current API consequences

1. storymodel4s core/atlas.scala: StorySource.fromText consumes an already-decoded Scala Unicode String. It rejects only `rawText.trim.isEmpty`, canonicalizes CRLF/CR, trailing spaces/tabs, excess blank lines, and leading/trailing LF, then computes decoded-raw and canonical UTF-8 checksums. Default StoryId is derived from canonical content.
2. AtlasSuite deliberately proves two raw strings may have the same StoryId and canonicalChecksum while rawChecksum differs. StoryId or canonicalChecksum alone is therefore not an invocation, cache, directory, or publication identity.
3. SurfaceAnalyzer.analyze deterministically builds checked paragraph, sentence, and token units over canonical UTF-16 coordinates without a provider. CoreCodecs already has checked SurfaceAtlas codecs and an atlasUnitsEncoder, but current main has no versioned standalone SurfaceAtlas artifact codec.
4. Pending docs candidate cand-7693N2JQAHERYGYGZEBTQE3WJZ / 76c62e738a2579d6598fccf3ac19266c60480e20 contains a runnable InspectSource.scala example, independently replayed against current APIs. It is not on main and is not an installed command.
5. StoryAtlas Main accepts only `edition --out`; Edition.build accepts StoryModel[Validated] but unconditionally declares ResearcherReviewedFixture. It cannot lawfully accept an arbitrary provider model. Edition.write uses createDirectories plus Files.write and can merge/overwrite a target, so it is not the accepted bundle publisher.
6. CodexHtml.render requires a PaginatedCodex. CodexFlow can be built only with ViewProvenance, whose current bases are validated, human, or reviewed fixture. Borrowing any of those for source-only output fabricates authority. A separate invocation-only SourcePreview over StorySource plus SurfaceAtlas is the smaller honest path.

Proposed command contract

```
storyatlas4s inspect --file <path> --out <absent-dir>
storyatlas4s inspect --stdin --out <absent-dir>
storyatlas4s inspect --text <unicode-string> --out <absent-dir>
```

Exactly one input selector is required. V1 selects strict UTF-8 only; no replacement policy and no user-selectable charset are needed to support arbitrary Unicode. File and stdin preserve their exact bytes in source.txt. `--text` starts after the shell/JVM decoding boundary, so it creates a deterministic UTF-8 capture of the received String, records argument mode plus that encoding policy, and never claims to know the shell's original bytes. Reject unpaired UTF-16 surrogates before that encoding so String.getBytes cannot silently replace them.

Command / identity / refusal matrix

| Stage or mode | Success establishes | Typed refusal and retained progress | Process result |
|---|---|---|---|
| parse | exactly one of file/stdin/text and one out target | missing/conflicting selector, missing value, duplicate option, unknown option; no bundle | 2 |
| file | exact bytes read from one regular file | unavailable/unreadable/not regular: source unavailable; if a result bundle can be prepared, source progress is before-intake | 1 |
| stdin | exact bytes through EOF | I/O failure retains only completed intake progress | 1 |
| text | exact received Unicode String plus deterministic UTF-8 capture and argument-mode receipt | unpaired surrogate refuses before encoding; no silent replacement | 1 |
| byte admission | byte length, SHA-256, text/plain, input mode, declared/selected charset, BOM disposition, derived intake receipt | none of these disappear if decode later fails | continue |
| strict UTF-8 decode | decoded UTF-16 length/checksum and decoder+REPORT-policy receipt; consume one leading UTF-8 BOM while retaining it in source.txt and recording ConsumedUtf8 | malformed/unmappable bytes report exact byte position and charset receipt; no decoded/canonical identity | 1, refusal bundle retained |
| StorySource.fromText | StoryId, decoded raw checksum, canonical UTF-8 bytes/length/checksum, canonicalization policy and receipt | whitespace/empty-after-decode retains original plus decoded identities but has no canonical identity/bytes | 1, refusal bundle retained |
| SurfaceAnalyzer | checked paragraphs/sentences/tokens over canonical UTF-16 axis and a versioned surface-artifact checksum bound to StoryId plus canonical checksum | invariant failure is integrity failure, never an empty atlas | 1 |
| semantics absent | source/surface success; target universe unestablished; semantic outcome uses the admitted output successor's non-success branch; zero targets/build receipt/ViewBasis/storymodel bytes | absence is expected state, not empty semantic success | continue |
| source preview | invocation-only HTML/text report with prominent `Semantics not established`, exact identities, canonical text, and surface units; zero semantic marks | HTML U+0000/unencodable failure preserves source/canonical/surface/result and independently accounts report/profile failure | 1 if required local-open profile fails |
| prepare | immutable source.txt, canonical.txt, surface-atlas.json, result.json, preview.html, preview.txt, then manifest.json; storymodel.json absent by semantic contract | cross-root mismatch/refusal never writes a final target | 1 |
| publish | external BundleId from canonical manifest and atomic exclusive no-replace publication | existing target, symlink/link/device, parent substitution, race, unsupported atomic-exclusive capability, or injected write failure; no overwrite or partial final target | 1 |
| complete source-only invocation | publication and required reports succeed even though semantics are unavailable | semantic absence alone is not an operational failure | 0 |

Identity chain

1. Input identity: mode plus original byte length/checksum, media type, declared/selected charset, BOM disposition, and derived intake receipt.
2. Decoded identity: UTF-16 length, UTF-8 checksum, and decoder implementation/configuration/error-policy receipt. For file/stdin this is a real strict decode; for --text the already-decoded boundary and deterministic UTF-8 capture are named explicitly.
3. StorySource identity: decoded raw checksum, canonical UTF-8 byte and UTF-16 lengths, canonical checksum, storysource-canonical-text/v1, canonicalization receipt, and StoryId.
4. Surface identity: canonical versioned SurfaceAtlas standoff bytes, bound to StoryId and canonical checksum. Prefer the existing atlasUnitsEncoder inside a new versioned codec root so original/canonical text is not duplicated.
5. Invocation/report identity: must bind every item above, the surface payload checksum/schema, source-only outcome/request, renderer config/software, and report request. It must not use StoryId as a substitute.
6. Bundle identity: SHA-256 of final canonical manifest bytes, external to the manifest.

The required collision court uses two byte-distinct files that canonicalize to one StoryId/canonical checksum. They may share canonical semantic/source coordinates and surface-unit bytes, but their original identities, intake/decode receipts, invocation identities, result/manifest bytes, and final bundles must remain distinct; neither may overwrite or cache-hit the other.

Proposed exact implementation paths, conditional on chief approval and an admitted output successor

storymodel4s, tiny versioned standoff-artifact prerequisite:

- codec/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/codec/surface.scala — `SurfaceAtlasArtifactCodec` only: schema version; encode atlas units with StoryId and canonical checksum; decode against an externally supplied StorySource through SurfaceAtlas.of; canonical checksum helper. This is new public wire vocabulary and requires explicit approval.
- codec/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/codec/SurfaceAtlasArtifactCodecSuite.scala — JVM/JS/Native round-trip, identity, mutation, no-source-duplication, astral-offset, parent/ordinal/span refusal, and raw-different/canonical-same control.

storyatlas4s, JVM application/renderer owner:

- build.sbt — advance the immutable storymodel4s pin only to the admitted output+surface-codec SHA; expose storymodel4s codecJVM ProjectRef to cli.
- cli/src/main/scala/storyatlas4s/cli/Main.scala — retain edition; add inspect dispatch and testable InputStream overload.
- cli/src/main/scala/storyatlas4s/cli/DirectInput.scala — exact file/stdin bytes, argument UTF-8 capture, strict decoder/BOM policy, actual-data-derived identities and refusals.
- cli/src/main/scala/storyatlas4s/cli/Inspect.scala — StorySource, SurfaceAnalyzer, surface artifact, output-account assembly, artifact bytes, process-status mapping.
- cli/src/main/scala/storyatlas4s/cli/SourcePreview.scala — invocation-only self-contained HTML/CSS plus complete deterministic textual twin; no CodexFlow/ViewBasis/semantic mark.
- cli/src/main/scala/storyatlas4s/cli/BundlePublisher.scala — prepared-byte validation and parent-anchored atomic exclusive no-replace publication; never call Edition.write.
- cli/src/test/scala/storyatlas4s/cli/DirectInputSuite.scala
- cli/src/test/scala/storyatlas4s/cli/InspectSuite.scala
- cli/src/test/scala/storyatlas4s/cli/SourcePreviewSuite.scala
- cli/src/test/scala/storyatlas4s/cli/BundlePublisherSuite.scala
- e2e/static/inspect.cjs — project-pinned Playwright file:// court and visual-QA screenshots, separate from the currently dirty static.cjs.

Do not touch Edition.scala, CodexHtml.scala, their current suites, or e2e/static/static.cjs in this first slice. Those files have unrelated uncommitted work. Do not add a storymodel4s CLI module: StoryAtlas is already the JVM CLI/application owner.

Dependency and authority gates before implementation

1. The output recovery bead must produce an immutable, chief-accepted successor; shared untracked bytes, blocked 8a110, and self-blocked ca9 are not a dependency pin.
2. The successor must provide or explicitly admit: source progress/outcome construction; invocation-only reports with no ViewBasis; a surface payload/reference seam; exact typed strict-decode failure detail including byte position and charset receipt; report-input binding; manifest closure; and an honest local-open profile verifier. If publication/prepared-bundle types are still absent, chief must explicitly assign the private StoryAtlas publisher boundary rather than treating the S1-S4 type candidate as an end-to-end bundle.
3. Source-only output requires no fixture/human issuer. The separate validated fixture route remains blocked until a real governed fixture issuer exists; never relabel War of the Ghosts as ValidatedBuild or reuse Edition.build's hard-coded fixture basis.
4. Chief approves the exact paths above, including the new versioned surface codec name/schema and whether surface-atlas.json is a known payload/projection-packet role.

Failure-capable author and consumer gate

- Build in standalone clones at exact SHAs. Run Storymodel codec tests on JVM, JS, and Native plus scalafmtCheckAll and compileAll for the two-path codec slice.
- In StoryAtlas run `scalafmtCheckAll compileAll testAll app/fastLinkJS` with exact storymodel4s/grakern/intaglio overrides; record SHAs, command, totals, and exit.
- Run all three commands. Independently recompute every artifact byte length/checksum and decode result/manifest/surface markup. Two identical invocations are byte-identical.
- Run strict-decode courts: malformed UTF-8 with exact offset; UTF-8 BOM; rejected UTF-16 BOM; whitespace-only post-decode refusal; astral characters; --text unpaired-surrogate refusal; U+0000 HTML failure with source artifacts retained.
- Run the identity mutant: keying invocation/cache/output by StoryId or canonical checksum makes the raw-different/canonical-same court fail.
- Run the authority negative control: source-only result has no semantic model, semantic projection, P/F/Viterbi, omission claim, ViewBasis, fixture id, or semantic `data-name`; adding any one fails.
- Run DOM reconstruction: designated text fragments concatenate byte-for-byte to canonical.txt; every paragraph/sentence/token span resolves on UTF-16 coordinates; HTML escaping does not change text.
- Run publication courts from accepted C18: existing empty/nonempty target, case-fold collision, symlink/link/device/stale staging, mid-write injection, final-target race, parent substitution, unsupported atomic-exclusive filesystem. No partial final target and no overwrite.
- Before browser automation run the repository browser guard audit. Use only project Playwright 1.55.1, open preview.html under file:// with dependent requests blocked, verify the explicit outcome banner, surface tables/links, focus order, non-colour cues, no external/script content, 200 percent zoom and print. Produce deterministic screenshots for human visual QA; screenshots are review evidence, not automated usability proof. Close the browser and rerun the guard audit.

Conclusion

Direct Unicode text input is a sound decision and the right first real-tool slice. It exercises landed deterministic science without waiting for semantic acquisition. It becomes unsound only if it loses byte/decoder identity, treats canonical StoryId as the invocation, borrows fixture/validated authority, emits empty semantic markup, or uses the legacy overwrite writer. The safe product is explicit: real source and standoff surface markup now; visible `Semantics not established`; semantic visualization only after admitted semantics.
